signals.tip: 听到 but / however / though 时，后面往往才是答案所在，前面常是干扰。
原因常出现在结果之前，注意 because / due to 后的内容。
语气词和态度词决定"说话人怎么看"，这类题几乎每年都考。
Why not / How about 后面是建议；Would you mind 后面是请求。
数字题要听"变化"而不是原数：delay、by、until、twice 都是陷阱。
听到这些词就能预判场景，场景决定答案方向。

script.en: I wanted to take Professor Lee’s seminar, but it clashes with my lab session.
script.cn: 我想选李教授的研讨课，但和我的实验课冲突。

script.en: Why not ask him whether you could attend the evening group instead?
script.cn: 为什么不问问他你能不能改上晚班那组？

script.en: That is a good idea, though the evening group is said to be far more demanding.
script.cn: 好主意，不过据说晚班那组要求高得多。

options: Two courses are scheduled at the same time.
questions.explain: clashes with = 与……时间冲突，是最直接的对应。
Why not… 是典型建议句式，后面即答案。

questions.q: What does the man imply about the evening group?
questions.explain: far more demanding = 要求高得多，对应 more work。

script.en: The heating in my flat has been out for three days, and nobody has come to fix it.
script.cn: 我公寓的暖气坏了三天，没人来修。

script.en: I am afraid the maintenance team is fully booked until Friday. Would a temporary heater help?
script.cn: 恐怕维修队到周五都排满了。先给你一个临时取暖器可以吗？

script.en: That would do for now, but I would like a written promise about the repair.
script.cn: 暂时可以，但我希望有个书面的维修承诺。

questions.q: What has happened to the woman’s flat?
options: The water supply was cut off.
questions.explain: heating has been out = 暖气停了三天的另一种说法。

questions.q: What does the woman ask for?
questions.explain: a written promise about the repair 直接对应。

script.en: I am calling about tomorrow’s interview. I have come down with flu.
script.cn: 我打电话是说说明天的面试，我得了流感。

script.en: I see. We could move you to Thursday morning, but the panel only meets once a week.
script.cn: 明白了。我们可以把你改到周四上午，但面试组一周只开一次会。

script.en: Thursday works for me. Thank you for being so flexible.
script.cn: 周四我可以。谢谢你们这么灵活。

questions.explain: move you to Thursday morning 说明是改期。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the panel?
questions.explain: only meets once a week = meets weekly。

dialogues.title: 短文 · 城市自行车道

script.en: Five years ago this city had almost no cycle lanes. Today more than two hundred kilometres of protected lanes run through the centre.
script.cn: 五年前这座城市几乎没有自行车道。如今市中心有超过两百公里的隔离车道。

script.en: The change began with a simple experiment: one street was closed to cars for a month.
script.cn: 改变始于一个简单的实验：一条街对汽车封闭了一个月。

script.en: Shop owners feared a loss of trade, yet sales rose by nearly a fifth, because cyclists stopped more often than drivers.
script.cn: 店主担心生意受损，但销售额上升了近五分之一，因为骑车的人比开车的人更常停下来。

script.en: The lesson is not that cars should be banned, but that a street designed for one kind of transport can quietly exclude everyone else.
script.cn: 这个教训并不是应该禁止汽车，而是只为一类交通方式设计的街道会悄悄排斥其他人。

options: With a vote by local shops.
With a new tax on cars.
questions.explain: one street was closed to cars for a month 对应 one-month experiment。
yet sales rose by nearly a fifth，yet 后面是转折重点。

questions.q: What is the speaker’s main point?
options: Cars should be banned in cities.
Street design decides who can use it.
questions.explain: not…but… 结构，重点是 but 之后的街头设计问题。

script.en: Students often trade sleep for study time before an exam. Research suggests this is a poor bargain.
script.cn: 学生考前常常用睡眠换学习时间。研究表明这是笔亏本买卖。

script.en: During deep sleep the brain replays what was learned that day, moving it into long-term storage.
script.cn: 在深度睡眠中，大脑会重放当天所学，把它转入长期储存。

script.en: In one study, students who slept eight hours recalled twenty percent more than those who stayed up.
script.cn: 在一项研究中，睡八小时的学生比熬夜的学生多记住百分之二十。

script.en: The practical advice is unglamorous: review in the evening, then sleep, rather than reading until dawn.
script.cn: 实用建议并不花哨：晚上复习，然后睡觉，而不是读到天亮。

questions.q: What do students often do before exams?
questions.explain: trade sleep for study time = 用睡眠换学习时间。

options: Memories are moved to long-term storage.
questions.explain: moving it into long-term storage 原意复现。

options: Reviewing in the evening then sleeping.
questions.explain: review in the evening, then sleep 直接对应。

script.en: Coworking spaces were designed for freelancers who disliked working alone at home.
script.cn: 共享办公空间最初是为不喜欢独自在家工作的自由职业者设计的。

script.en: Today large firms rent desks there too, mainly to keep small teams away from head office.
script.cn: 如今大公司也在那里租工位，主要是让小团队远离总部。

script.en: The appeal is not the furniture but the accidental conversations that lead to new ideas.
script.cn: 吸引人的不是家具，而是那些偶然发生、能带来新想法的交谈。

script.en: Yet the same openness makes concentration difficult, so many members work from home on deadline days.
script.cn: 然而同样的开放也让专注变难，所以很多成员在赶工时选择在家办公。

questions.q: Who were coworking spaces first intended for?
questions.explain: designed for freelancers 原词复现。

questions.q: Why do large firms use them?
options: To cut rent for head office.
To keep small teams separate from head office.
questions.explain: keep small teams away from head office。
makes concentration difficult，yet 引出缺点。
